name: LLMCheck: Apple M5 Max (128GB), MLX, Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M decode
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (LLMCheck open dataset). M5 Max 128GB, MLX engine, Llama 3.3 70B Q4_K_M, TTFT 2.4 s, per-request decode.
notes: MLX vs Ollama lands at the same 12 tok/s on this model — decode on a dense 70B at Q4 is pure bandwidth, so the engine difference is noise-level.
